label: provides service
type: the subject node runs an instance of the object service. The placement relation underlying Multi-Dimensional Scaling.
note: PROMOTED BELOW THRESHOLD, as part of the documented Multi-Dimensional Scaling family (providesService, requiresMinimumNodeCount, requiresMemoryQuota, exemptFromMemoryQuota, hasInternalServiceIdentifier). No single member except requiresMinimumNodeCount crosses the two-page bar, but together they cover one well-evidenced mechanism that services.md documents in full and that the registry could not express at all: services as independently placeable, independently quota'd, independently scalable components on named nodes. The family exception in the reconcile skill is being used deliberately here, not silently.
relates_to_competency_question: Which services run on which nodes?
